selection: the calculator view with its three components
description: The calculator page of a phrase (docs/llm/new_view_sample_pv_balance.md): the title, the inputs and the results are the same three components for every calculator, and what they show is selected by the calculator triples of the phrase (calculator_keywords.json). The view style use-case shows the title as the header and the inputs beside the results. The calculator view itself is created by system_views.json, so that it keeps its database id, and gets its components here; the comparison table, which shows the values of a phrase with the defined columns, is created here, and its two components of system_views.json are repeated unchanged, because the import links a view only to the components of its own file. The formula editor of the formulas of a page and its component are appended at the end, so that no database id moves. This file is imported as the last step of the db setup, so that no database id of a tested view or component moves.

components.name: phrase title
components.description: show the phrase name as the page title with the subheader of a word (the related phrases) or of a triple (the from, verb and to with links)

components.name: table with related columns
components.description: all values related to this word or triple as a table with one column per phrase used most often within the values and one row per remaining phrase combination

components.name: title calculator
components.description: the calculator label of the phrase as the title, else the phrase name, and the calculator hint as the lead text

components.name: calculator input
components.description: the input fields and the assumptions that the calculator triples of the phrase select, in their order, with the save button

components.name: calculation result
components.description: the result table and the detail tables that the calculator triples of the phrase select, with the notes of the formulas and the sources of the values

components.name: formula editor
components.description: the editor of the formulas of the page of the phrase with the results until now and after the save, built by a script from the phrase data of the phrase

views.name: Comparison table
views.description: the values related to a word or triple as a table with the defined columns, so that the numbers of a question can be compared, e.g. the avoided emission of PV in Switzerland with and without the displacement mix concept

views.name: Calculator
views.description: the inputs, the assumptions and the results of a calculation for a word or triple, selected by its calculator triples

views.name: Formula editor
views.description: the editor of the formulas that the calculator page of a word or triple uses, with the results until now and after the save

view_relations.description: the edit menu of the calculator offers the calculator editor with the same phrase
